maskedRegions.reason: the WHO emblem and its wordmark. The owner ruled on 2026-09-21 that the emblem on a cover counts as "logo and other branding", which this replica must not carry until it is published under WHO, and chose masking over withholding the covers. Region placed by an emblem detector (template match) and the text guess in scripts/iris-covers/render-previews.py, then checked by eye on the rendering (who-iris#207).
